headline: Move from RFP requirements to a reviewable proposal structure
capabilities: Parse RFP requirements and draft compliance checklists instantly
Assemble tailored executive summaries and competitive positioning
outcomes: Developed a complete, branded proposal package in minutes
Improved proposal quality and alignment with buyer priorities
Enabled same-day turnaround for competitive opportunities
Freed sales teams to pursue more deals without sacrificing proposal quality
why_try: A bid manager can see how buyer requirements map to evidence and where human review is still required before anything becomes customer ready.

sample_prompts.label: Analyze the RFP
sample_prompts.prompt: Analyze the synthetic Meridian Healthcare RFP and show the traceable requirement checklist.

sample_prompts.label: Draft the executive summary
sample_prompts.prompt: Draft an executive summary for the synthetic Meridian Healthcare opportunity that reflects the buyer priorities and remains subject to review.

sample_prompts.label: Review pricing assumptions
sample_prompts.prompt: Compare the synthetic solution and pricing assumptions for Meridian Healthcare without approving a price, discount, or concession.

sample_prompts.label: Prepare competitive positioning
sample_prompts.prompt: Prepare synthetic reference and competitive positioning options for Meridian Healthcare, with availability checks before use.

sample_prompts.label: Outline the proposal package
sample_prompts.prompt: Outline the synthetic Meridian Healthcare proposal package and every human review required before delivery.

sample_prompts.label: Summarize draft readiness
sample_prompts.prompt: Summarize the synthetic Meridian Healthcare draft readiness and the decisions authorized reviewers must make next.

business_flow: Account executive, sales leader, or bid manager
